title: Cane Creek Invert Tuxedo: Limited Edition Gravel Suspension
content:
The Cane Creek Invert, now in a handsome white-and-champagne colorway for a limited-edition release dubbed “Tuxedo.” While the normal Invert might fit in at a black-tie gala, the limited-edition version is sure to steal the show. Read below for all the well-dressed details.

Invert is the most fun you’ve ever had on gravel. It smoothes your ride and gives unbelievable control so you can relax into rough roads, loose turns, and steep descents. It’s surprisingly lightweight, easy to live with, and will help you unlock speed and comfort you never thought possible. This is the suspension fork that gravel bikes have been waiting for.

Beneath the Tuxedo is the Invert CS, with 40 mm or 30 mm of fork travel and a Climb Switch. When clicked, the climb switch dramatically reduces the amount of fork movement for pedaling out of the saddle. The Climb Switch button is inspired by the simple click of a pen and is as satisfying to click as the feature is to use.

This limited edition pairs a gloss white upper with ‘champagne’ natural, hard anodized lower legs and black accents. Only 50 will be made. Each is hand-built in Fletcher, NC.

See the Invert Tuxedo at Cane Creek.
